fields.name: PgConnectionConfiguration resolved connection identity
fields.description: The externally exposed identity of the PostgreSQL endpoint after PgConnectionConfiguration resolves database and host across its configuration hierarchy. The value is cached; the cache is cleared by SetAmbientConfiguration, by a PropertyChanged on the configuration's own (local) properties, and by a PropertyChanged on any currently supplied inherited level, and is overwritten whenever GetConnectionString builds the connection string.

members.name: ConnectionDescription
members.description: Formatted as "database {Database} on server {Host}". When computed by the ConnectionDescription getter, each segment uses the latest non-null, non-empty (string.IsNullOrEmpty) Database or Host among global, shard-set, read/write, shard, and local values. When set by GetConnectionString, each segment is the built connection string's value, where every non-null level value — including an empty string — overrides earlier levels. The two agree unless some level supplies an empty Database or Host.
